title: PHP Conference Kansai 2026
content:
We are excited to announce PHP Conference Kansai 2026! 🎉

About the conference

PHP Conference Kansai is a technical conference where PHP engineers in the Kansai region of Japan share their knowledge and experience. It started in 2011 and came back in 2024 in Osaka after a six-year break. It was held in Kobe in 2025, and this edition will be held in Kyoto.

The theme of this edition is "次は、ここから始まる。" (What's next starts here.) AI has dramatically changed the way we work. But the quality of the answers you get from AI depends on how much you know when you ask. To ask the right questions and judge whether an answer holds up, you need to learn from others and see beyond your own perspective. At the conference, through sessions, talks, and casual conversations around the venue, you can talk with people who have a shared knowledge base. We want it to be a place where everyone who comes finds their own "next."

Note: Despite its name, the conference takes place in January 2027.

Who can join?

Anyone involved with PHP is welcome, whether you use it now, used it before, or are just curious about it. (All talks will be in Japanese.)
